# agent/secret-in-config

Credential in agent or MCP config.

A literal token in an agent or MCP config file (`.mcp.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json`, `.claude/settings*.json`, `.codex/config.toml`, `.gemini/settings.json`, and similar): env values, headers, bearer tokens, server arguments, and URL parameters with credential names.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: Values in a known provider format (sk-..., ghp_..., xoxb-...) are reported by secret/provider-key instead. Test and example folders report at warn.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html), OWASP A07:2025, OWASP ASI04.

## Why it matters

These files are committed and shared, and agents read them, so a token in them reaches everyone with access to the repository and every model that loads the config. Config files support env references so the value can stay out of the file.

## Flagged

`.claude/settings.json` (block):

```json
"INTERNAL_API_TOKEN": "<high-entropy>",
```

`.codex/config.toml` (block):

```toml
env = { SEARCH_TOKEN = "<high-entropy>" }
```

`.gemini/settings.json` (block):

```json
"X-API-Key": "<high-entropy>"
```

`.mcp.json` (block):

```json
"SEARCH_API_KEY": "<high-entropy>"
```

`.mcp.json` (block):

```json
"Authorization": "Bearer <high-entropy>"
```

## Not flagged

- `"NODE_ENV": "development",` in `.claude/settings.json`: not a credential
- `"SESSION_TOKEN_TTL": "3600",` in `.claude/settings.json`: a number is a setting, not a secret
- `"AUTH_MODE": "oauth2-device-flow"` in `.claude/settings.json`: a setting written as words
- `bearer_token_env_var = "REMOTE_MCP_TOKEN"` in `.codex/config.toml`: the token is read from an environment variable
- `"GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN": "ghp_...1BTx"` in `.mcp.json`: a known provider format is reported by secret/provider-key instead
- `"LINEAR_API_KEY": "${LINEAR_API_KEY}"` in `.mcp.json`: env reference
- `"DATABASE_URL": "postgres://app:<db-password>@db.internal.example.com:5432/app",` in `.mcp.json`: connection strings are reported by secret/db-url-password
- `"API_KEY": "your-api-key-here",` in `.mcp.json`: placeholder
- `"LOG_LEVEL": "debug"` in `.mcp.json`: not a credential name
- `"env": { "TICKETS_API_KEY": "${input:tickets-key}" }` in `.vscode/mcp.json`: VS Code asks for the value at run time

## How to fix

Replace the value with an env reference such as "${API_KEY}", keep the value in your shell or an ignored .env file, and rotate the exposed token.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore agent/secret-in-config: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "agent/secret-in-config": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
